settings.subs.title: Subscriptions
settings.subs.subtitle: Topics to listen to, grouped by broker. Each matching subscription creates its own notification.
settings.subs.noBrokers: Add a broker first, then add subscriptions to it.
settings.subs.topicHint: + matches one level, # matches the rest (last level only).
settings.subs.descriptionHint: Shown in the desktop notification title.
settings.subs.ignoreRetainedHint: Skip the stored message a broker replays every time the subscription is (re)created.
settings.parser.title: Parser script
settings.parser.help: Optional JavaScript that turns the payload into a notification. Input: msgin (payload as text). Outputs: msgout (text), msgicon (ICON_NOTIFY, ICON_QUESTION, ICON_WARN, ICON_ERROR, ICON_OK or null), msglink (http/https URL or null). "return false" ignores the message; any other ending keeps it. Helpers: JSON, parseXml(text), to_string(value). Leave empty to show the payload as-is.
settings.parser.fromFile: Loaded from parsers/%1 — saving writes the file.
settings.parser.samplePlaceholder: Paste a payload to test the parser with
settings.parser.fallback: Parser failed — this fallback would be shown
settings.parser.dropped: Ignored — the script returned false, so no notification would be created
settings.storage.title: Storage
settings.storage.subtitle: Notification history kept on this computer.
settings.storage.maxHint: Oldest notifications are removed beyond this. Applied immediately.
settings.storage.importHint: Merges an export into the history; notifications already present are skipped.
settings.storage.noExports: Exports appear here. To import another file, copy it into %1.
